title: Audit admin export API authorization boundary
detail: Scope: packages/api@0.2.0 commit a1b2c3d. Focus on /api/admin/export and shared policy helpers.

title: Can a team member export another team's objects?
detail: Independent check: object ownership vs team membership on GET /api/admin/export.

title: Does the MIME helper erase a missing ACL check?
detail: Follow-up after final response helpers. Separate from object ACL.

title: Export checks team role but not object tenant
detail: Handler requires admin.team role, then loads ExportJob by id without comparing job.teamId to caller.teamId.

title: Shared policy layer already enforces object ACL
detail: Competing explanation: loadExportJob may call assertObjectAccess before return.

title: Content-Type override does not create XSS here
detail: Helper forces text/csv for export; browser script execution not demonstrated. Kept as ruled-out candidate.

title: Route only asserts requireRole('admin.export')
detail: No subsequent tenant comparison in handler body through line 146.
label: Role check only

title: loadExportJob returns row without team filter
detail: SQL: SELECT * FROM export_jobs WHERE id = $1. team_id column unused in WHERE.
label: Missing tenant predicate

title: assertObjectAccess exists but is not called from export path
detail: Used by /api/objects/:id. Grep shows no call from admin/export.ts.
label: Helper unused on this path

title: Caller has admin.export on some team
detail: Necessary for the handler to proceed past auth middleware.

title: Target ExportJob id is attacker-controlled
detail: id comes from query string; no allow-list.

title: Static path confirmed; runtime PoC not executed
detail: No live tenant. Marked static-confirmed only.
label: Evidence maturity

title: respondCsv sets Content-Type: text/csv; charset=utf-8
detail: Overrides caller-supplied type. No HTML body on this branch.
label: Safe type for this sink

title: Checked: admin export GET; not checked: async worker consumers
